title: Valid Palindrome III
summary: Given a string s and an integer k , determine if s can be transformed into a palindrome by removing at most k characters from it.
statement: Given a string s and an integer k , determine if s can be transformed into a palindrome by removing at most k characters from it.
constraints: Delete at most k characters from s.
Return whether the remaining characters can form a palindrome without reordering.
s is nonempty and k is nonnegative.
hints: Compute minimum deletions for every substring.
Matching endpoints inherit the inner cost; differing endpoints delete one side plus the better remaining substring.
Fill intervals from short to long and compare the whole-string cost with k.
The recurrence exhausts the only two choices at a mismatch and preserves matching endpoints optimally.
editorial: The recurrence exhausts the only two choices at a mismatch and preserves matching endpoints optimally.

tests.explanation: Deleting b and e leaves acdca, a palindrome.
Deleting one suitable character produces a palindrome.
